name: python-error-handling
description: Robust Python validation, exception design, typed boundaries, partial-failure batches, and user-friendly API errors.

Validate inputs early, before expensive operations; report all validation errors at once when possible. Use contextual, appropriate exception types; explain failure, cause, and fix. In batch operations, don't let one failure abort everything. Track successes and failures separately. Chain and preserve original exceptions. Parse external data into typed domain objects at API boundaries. Use Pydantic `BaseModel`, `Field`, and `field_validator`. Create structured domain exceptions. Never let one bad item abort an entire batch. Track results per item. Expose batch progress independently of UI.
